QA-SF-001.finding: Storage-first admission accepts stale authority and rebound plan, identity, known-host, bounded-proof, nonce-ledger, and consumer-impact bindings.
QA-SF-001.observed: RED: planner 1 test with 5 subfailures and adapter 1 test with 8 subfailures; every mutated admission was accepted, producing AssertionError: Exception not raised.

QA-SF-002.finding: Storage-first provider callbacks receive the raw node projection and can observe credential_seam.
QA-SF-002.observed: RED: callback recorder observed credential_seam; assertion failed with provider callbacks must receive the credential-free transport projection.

QA-SF-003.finding: Live trust-root, identity, authority, known-host, nonce-ledger, and impact revalidation is optional rather than mandatory before every mutation.
QA-SF-003.observed: RED: execute_storage_first without live_revalidator did not raise and recorded provider mutations; assertion failed with Exception not raised.

QA-SF-004.finding: Minimal receipts and journals without required transaction, capture-window, trust, authority, and binding evidence are accepted.
QA-SF-004.observed: RED: both minimal receipt and minimal prepared journal were accepted; each assertion failed with Exception not raised.

QA-SF-005.finding: Side-effect-then-throw persists reconciliation-blocked but omits the governed reobserve plus clean-redeploy handoff.
QA-SF-005.observed: RED: journal retained reconciliation-blocked and reconciliation-required, but reconciliation_requirements was absent (None != expected handoff).

red_contract.expected_green_gate: All finding-specific tests must pass only after strict admission/binding checks, secret-free callback projection, mandatory live revalidation, closed receipt/journal schemas, and governed reconciliation handoff are implemented.

release_assessment.release_confidence: none for storage-first security closure until all twelve current RED failure points are GREEN at the frozen implementation head
residual_risks: These tests intentionally specify RED behavior and do not claim production security closure.
No real node/provider transport, credential seam, signed authority, trust-root file, or remote package was accessed.
Downstream implementation must rerun this exact focused suite and the relevant release-gate suites at the resulting immutable head.
